response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. Hands-on C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis project — far short of the mandated 5–10 years of Windows C++ development. There is no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was fintech-adjacent but built on Node/TypeScript), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth. Their recent stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) is largely orthogonal to this position.
strengths: Long, consistent engineering career with senior/staff-level roles and strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Experience building low-latency, high-throughput systems (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and open-source leadership
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and over a decade ago — far below the mandatory 5–10 years
No Fixed Income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle expertise or Windows-platform development focus

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and CI/CD knowledge
